producer.name: Microsoft Publisher
producer.appearance: Explicit frame fonts, margins and object colors; untouched native publication defaults.

observed: 15 independent US English frames on 15 pages: narrow-word and full-line word breaks, pair-kerning defaults and a three-frame linked story. Application options are observed without changing them.
limits: Font binary and existing native option profile are recorded. Native dictionary breaks, pair kerning and source-versus-display hyphen transport remain separate managed implementation work. Native repair is unassessed.

paragraphSuppression.derivation: Source-only FDPP OPL field0x1C/type0x0A in every paragraph. Story text, formatting endpoints and every other compound stream remain unchanged before native validation. Native read-only open, PDF export, SaveAs, reopen and second PDF export; stored PUB/PDF are native-resaved artifacts.
paragraphSuppression.observed: True 0x0A suppresses generated hyphens on 13 of 15 pages; false 0x02 retains enabled reference behavior and normalizes to omission. All 15 initial/resaved page pairs are identical at 144 dpi. Story flags remain enabled; no global application options were written.
paragraphSuppression.limits: Source-derived control does not establish independent native creation, repair-free opening or dictionary parity. Earlier 0x00/0x08 paragraph encodings were ineffective and removed by native save.
